rev.t: Art beat located in HSR layout is a treasure for budding artists and for attending some bang-on workshops. I've been here twice for attending their canvas painting, resin art workshops. They have pottery workshop as a complimentary for all …

I’d like to start with the positives. This place seemed to have a lot of potential, and the artwork on display was genuinely impressive. The staff were polite, welcoming, and appeared to be well-organized. …
Thank you, Art Beat, for creating such a wonderful learning environment, and a heartfelt thank you to David for being an incredible mentor. …
